{"parentUuid":"848ad6d7-2016-4ef9-ad48-b8f9d7698f8e","isSidechain":false,"attachment":{"type":"mcp_instructions_delta","addedNames":["plugin:context7:context7","plugin:serena:serena"],"addedBlocks":["## plugin:context7:context7\nUse this server to fetch current documentation whenever the user asks about a library, framework, SDK, API, CLI tool, or cloud service -- even well-known ones like React, Next.js, Prisma, Express, Tailwind, Django, or Spring Boot. This includes API syntax, configuration, version migration, library-specific debugging, setup instructions, and CLI tool usage. Use even when you think you know the answer -- your training data may not reflect recent changes. Prefer this over web search for library docs.\n\nDo not use for: refactoring, writing scripts from scratch, debugging business logic, code review, or general programming concepts.","## plugin:serena:serena\nCRITICAL: Before starting to work on a coding task, call the `initial_instructions` tool to read the 'Serena Instructions Manual'."],"removedNames":[]},"type":"attachment","uuid":"9a05b91c-59a6-4c40-8e46-03716f1ac47e","timestamp":"2026-05-05T12:30:30.197Z","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"C:\\htdocs\\stockforge","sessionId":"040b98a4-76e6-42d6-8df9-28986cf96d89","version":"2.1.124","gitBranch":"main"}
{"parentUuid":"9a05b91c-59a6-4c40-8e46-03716f1ac47e","isSidechain":false,"attachment":{"type":"skill_listing","content":"- update-config: Use this skill to configure the Claude Code harness via settings.json. Automated behaviors (\"from now on when X\", \"each time X\", \"whenever X\", \"before/after X\") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions (\"allow X\", \"add permission\", \"move permission to\"), env vars (\"set X=Y\"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. Examples: \"allow npm commands\", \"add bq permission to global settings\", \"move permission to user settings\", \"set DEBUG=true\", \"when claude stops show X\". For simple settings like theme/model, suggest the /config command.\n- keybindings-help: Use when the user wants to customize keyboard shortcuts, rebind keys, add chord bindings, or modify ~/.claude/keybindings.json. Examples: \"rebind ctrl+s\", \"add a chord shortcut\", \"change the submit key\", \"customize keybindings\".\n- simplify: Review changed code for reuse, quality, and efficiency, then fix any issues found.\n- fewer-permission-prompts: Scan your transcripts for common read-only Bash and MCP tool calls, then add a prioritized allowlist to project .claude/settings.json to reduce permission prompts.\n- loop: Run a prompt or slash command on a recurring interval (e.g. /loop 5m /foo). Omit the interval to let the model self-pace. - When the user wants to set up a recurring task, poll for status, or run something repeatedly on an interval (e.g. \"check the deploy every 5 minutes\", \"keep running /babysit-prs\"). Do NOT invoke for one-off tasks.\n- schedule: Create, update, list, or run scheduled remote agents (routines) that execute on a cron schedule. - When the user wants to schedule a recurring remote agent, set up automated tasks, create a cron job for Claude Code, or manage their scheduled agents/routines. Also use when the user wants a one-time scheduled run (\"run this once at 3pm\", \"remind me to check X tomorrow\").\n- claude-api: Build, debug, and optimize Claude API / Anthropic SDK apps. Apps built with this skill should include prompt caching. Also handles migrating existing Claude API code between Claude model versions (4.5 → 4.6, 4.6 → 4.7, retired-model replacements).\nTRIGGER when: code imports `anthropic`/`@anthropic-ai/sdk`; user asks for the Claude API, Anthropic SDK, or Managed Agents; user adds/modifies/tunes a Claude feature (caching, thinking, compaction, tool use, batch, files, citations, memory) or model (Opus/Sonnet/Haiku) in a file; questions about prompt caching / cache hit rate in an Anthropic SDK project.\nSKIP: file imports `openai`/other-provider SDK, filename like `*-openai.py`/`*-generic.py`, provider-neutral code, general programming/ML.\n- ccs-delegation: Auto-activate CCS CLI delegation for deterministic tasks. Parses user input, auto-selects optimal profile (glm/kimi/custom) from ~/.ccs/config.json, enhances prompts with context, executes via `ccs {profile} -p \"task\"` or `ccs {profile}:continue`, and reports results. Triggers on \"use ccs [task]\" patterns, typo/test/refactor keywords. Excludes complex architecture, security-critical code, performance optimization, breaking changes.\n- attach: Port the Claude Code harness layer from this project to a new project directory. Use when bootstrapping a fresh Claude Code project on the same machine, when peers want to copy the harness, or when verifying layer separation via dry-run. Reads .claude/manifest.yaml; copies harness-tagged artifacts only; excludes stockforge biz + personal layers; generates skeleton CLAUDE.md + manifest at target.\n- crawler-reliability: Build reliable web crawlers for data gathering. Use when implementing scrapers for CafeF, NDH, VietnamBiz, YouTube (yt-dlp), Facebook fanpages, or any external data source. Covers Python/Playwright patterns, retry/backoff, selector robustness, rate limiting, monitoring.\n- ddd-tactical-patterns: Apply DDD tactical patterns (aggregate, entity, value object, repository, domain event, anti-corruption layer) correctly in Python/dataclasses code. Use when designing or implementing domain models, repositories, or cross-bounded-context communication in StockForge's 9 BCs.\n- decompose-work: Split a non-trivial task into deterministic-vs-LLM portions before execution. Use when planning multi-step work where some sub-tasks are mechanical (file ops, regex, count, schema validation) and others require judgment (synthesis, design, ambiguity resolution). Outputs structured plan that maps each portion to the cheapest competent tool. Pairs with capability-map.md (model × effort × task_class grounding) and try-n-approaches (S9 — Karpathy autoresearch loop).\n- empirical-probe-first: Probe ALL viable strategies in a multi-option ladder BEFORE committing to one. Use when a session-plan / decision-ADR / spec presents ≥3 strategy options (e.g. \"Strategy A1/A2/A3\" or \"alternative B/C/D\") and the recommended option's source-evidence may be stale. Outputs a probe matrix per strategy + commit decision with empirical citation. Pairs with `vendor-api-probe.sh` (deterministic detection layer; SessionStart hook) and `decompose-work` (deterministic-vs-LLM split per probe). Charter promotion target — codifies L-S32-1 doctrine surfaced at S32 Track A pivot (master-plan recommended A2 vnstock alternate; empirical probe rejected A1+A2; A3 SSI direct httpx adopted instead).\n- evidence-extraction: Extract structured claims from unstructured sources with citation integrity. Use when building extraction pipelines, parsing news articles or KOL transcripts, or anywhere claims are created from raw data. Ensures every claim has source_url, extracted_at, confidence, and verified attribution. Enforces no-LLM-math invariant (I-S1).\n- fastapi-module: Implement FastAPI routers following StockForge conventions. Use when creating a new HTTP endpoint, adding routes, wiring dependency injection, configuring Pydantic DTOs. Covers router boundaries, provider patterns, testing setup. Phase 2+ only — Phase 1 uses Streamlit dashboard directly.\n- grill-maximization: Doctrine for bundling Q&A questions to the human at maximum density per turn (15-20 target, max 25), so each human-in-the-loop touchpoint is information-rich. Use when composing a Q&A bundle for human-workspace/q-and-a/pending/, or when deciding whether to ask one question or wait and bundle. Built on the principle that human-in-the-loop time is the scarcest resource in autonomous coding.\n- hook-diagnostics: Inspect hook event lifecycle (state machine + transcript cache + aggregator output) when triaging failed/stuck hooks or auditing self-awareness rollups. Use during sandwich-verifier review, drift investigation, or post-mortem when component-telemetry.jsonl + dispatch.jsonl + sessions-rollup.tsv need cross-checking.\n- obsidian-vault: Search, create, and manage notes in the StockForge Obsidian vault with wikilinks, frontmatter, and index maintenance. Use when adding content to the knowledge base, navigating entities/concepts, or maintaining the raw/wiki separation. Adapted from mattpocock/skills, MIT licensed. Extended with raw/wiki pattern from Karpathy LLM Wiki.\n- postgres-pgvector: Design Postgres schemas with pgvector and TimescaleDB for StockForge. Use when creating migrations, designing tables, writing queries. Covers vector embeddings for semantic search on Vietnamese text, time-series for price/sentiment data, JSONB vs structured columns.\n- promote-rule: Cluster agent-notes.md entries by lexical similarity, propose promotion of recurring rules to deterministic hook (priority 1), skill (priority 2), or charter (priority 3). Use when agent-notes has accumulated ≥10 new rules since last promotion run, or on-demand at phase boundary. Outputs proposal markdown to observations/. Pairs with capability-map.md (writes new task_class entries) and decompose-work (consumes promotion outcomes).\n- prompt-engineering: Design and optimize LLM prompts for StockForge pipeline stages. Use when writing or refining prompts for claim extraction, KOL recommendation extraction, sentiment analysis, thesis synthesis. Covers context assembly, prompt caching strategy, budget-aware prompts, structured output. Enforces no-LLM-math constraint.\n- qa-escalation: File-based Q&A protocol — composes bundle file in human-workspace/q-and-a/pending/, tracks lifecycle (pending → answered → stale → processed), creates URGENT notification when needed. Use when intent classifier recommends OPEN_QA_BUNDLE / ESCALATE_HUMAN, or grill-maximization has a bundle ready to write. Pairs with grill-maximization (composes content) + Track 5 hooks (auto-move stale).\n- session-memory-l0-l1: Extract structured memories (L0 quick metadata + L1 deep) from a Claude Code session JSONL transcript. L0 is pure regex (file paths, commands, errors, failures incl. Vietnamese phrases, next step). L1 ships the prompt builder + response parser + 15+35 head/tail windowing — caller dispatches the LLM (no auto-invoke in Phase 0). Plus cleanText harness-stripper + TranscriptCache (mtime+size dual-check + LRU). Use when ingesting a session for memory promotion, computing what files/commands/failures the session touched, or preparing an offline LLM extraction.\n- spec-dual-layer: Write specifications with dual-layer structure (business narrative + agent contract). Use when authoring new specs, refining existing specs, or understanding the spec template. Ensures both human stakeholder needs and agent execution needs are served.\n- spec-to-wiki: Convert raw specifications to Obsidian wiki format with wikilinks, frontmatter, and index updates. Use when adding a new spec to the knowledge base, or when regenerating wiki view after spec changes. Maintains raw as source of truth, wiki as navigable view.\n- sync-pull: On-demand confidence-score lookup before a SCOPE+/ARCH/IMPL decision. Reads agent-workspace/memory/sync-tracker/state.tsv + weights.yaml; surfaces the relevant category's score, tier, must-grill flag, and the decision-class threshold. Output drives \"self-decide vs grill\" choice. Use whenever an agent is about to commit a non-trivial decision and needs to ground confidence in historical hit rate per Charter Principle 8 (Calibration over confidence).\n- test-pyramid-balance: Balance unit, integration, and E2E tests properly in Python/pytest. {"parentUuid":"ae6433b5-488f-4327-92c1-b58b4ae56836","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"92b794ca-9b18-4eb5-a4d7-9638ef1b6181","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01Tyjt2amb8svnknX2HkYAQ8","type":"tool_result","content":"1\t# PROJECT CHARTER\n2\t## StockForge — Personal Investment Advisor for Vietnamese Stock Market\n3\t\n4\t> **Status**: Immutable v1.0 — changes require explicit charter revision.\n5\t> **Scope of immutability**: Vision, principles, success criteria.\n6\t> **Things that do evolve**: Agent configs, specs, implementation, signal weights, eval sets.\n7\t\n8\t---\n9\t\n10\t## Vision\n11\t\n12\tAn AI-first investment research and advisory system that combines **quant fund methodology** with **Vietnam-specific edge sources** (KOL networks, crowd sentiment, pump pattern detection) to surface high-conviction opportunities in an inefficient market where logic-based screening alone is insufficient.\n13\t\n14\tPrimary user: project owner (self) + 3-5 trusted peers in Vietnamese investing community.\n15\t\n16\tPrimary goal: build a system that compounds edge over time through proprietary data accumulation, not through any single clever algorithm. After 12-24 months of dogfood, the system should be a genuine advisor I would pay money for if someone else built it.\n17\t\n18\tNot a goal: high-frequency trading, replacing human judgment, becoming a SaaS in Year 1, beating frontier LLMs at general reasoning, providing licensed financial advice.\n19\t\n20\t---\n21\t\n22\t## The Core Insight (the why)\n23\t\n24\t**Quant funds (Renaissance, Two Sigma, DE Shaw) win in efficient markets through clean data + execution speed + diverse alpha factors.** They don't use sentiment from Facebook/YouTube because at their scale it's noise, not signal — and in efficient markets it gets arbitraged away anyway.\n25\t\n26\t**Vietnam stock market inverts this.** It is structurally inefficient:\n27\t- 85-90% retail investor share (vs 20-25% in US)\n28\t- Information asymmetry between sophisticated and retail crowd\n29\t- KOL/influencer recommendations measurably move prices\n30\t- \"Đội lái\" (pump operators) operate openly\n31\t- News and narrative cycles dominate over fundamentals for months at a time\n32\t- Foreign flow creates non-fundamental price pressure\n33\t\n34\tIn this market, **sentiment + influence + narrative tracking is signal, not noise**. And LLMs can process Vietnamese unstructured text at scale that was impossible before 2023.\n35\t\n36\tThis creates a **structural arbitrage**: apply quant methodology + LLM reasoning + sentiment/influence data layers that no commercial product offers for VN. Position not as \"decision maker\" but as **advisor + alert watcher + bias mirror**.\n37\t\n38\t---\n39\t\n40\t## The Craft Philosophy\n41\t\n42\tTake the craft seriously. Build for personal use first, commercial second.\n43\t\n44\t- Production-grade engineering standards from Day 1 (DDD + clean architecture + multi-loop discipline)\n45\t- Commercial extension kept as option, never as driver\n46\t- When self-use conflicts with hypothetical-future-SaaS, self-use wins\n47\t- Quality bar: I genuinely trust output enough to act on real money decisions\n48\t- Edge comes from compounding moats (proprietary data, calibration, personal bias log), not from any single feature\n49\t\n50\tReference models: Renaissance Technologies (data + iteration discipline), Bridgewater (principles-based decision making), personal Bloomberg Terminal (data density + analysis depth), Athletic.com (subscription-quality content for niche audience).\n51\t\n52\t---\n53\t\n54\t## Core Principles (non-negotiable)\n55\t\n56\t1. **Evidence grounding** — every claim, every number traceable to source + as-of date. Hallucination in finance = bug, not stylistic issue.\n57\t\n58\t2. **Structured output over narrative** — multi-criteria assessment, never single \"buy/sell\" score. Output is trade-off matrix.\n59\t\n60\t3. **Adversarial by design** — bear + bull + critic + quant + behavior + manager perspectives. Never consensus from single agent.\n61\t\n62\t4. **Proprietary data moat** — every news ingested, every KOL recommendation tracked, every thesis post-mortem'd compounds the edge. Raw data is sacred.\n63\t\n64\t5. **Pattern transfer + local adaptation** — global setups (cyclical bottom, dividend value, GARP) + Vietnam-specific overlays (policy timing, foreign flow, narrative phase).\n65\t\n66\t6. **Human-in-loop is the product** — augment thinking, never replace it. System should challenge user's gut instinct without overriding it.\n67\t\n68\t7. **Dogfood mandatory** — if I don't use it weekly for real decisions, the feature gets killed. Self-use is the only validation that matters in Year 1.\n69\t\n70\t8. **Calibration over confidence** — system tracks its own accuracy across signal types, never claims confidence it hasn't earned through hit rate.\n71\t\n72\t9. **No LLM math** — LLM never generates numbers. All calculations through deterministic code with verified data inputs. LLM only interprets.\n73\t\n74\t10. **Position sizing & risk management are deterministic** — code-enforced rules, LLM cannot override. Maximum position size, sector concentration, stop loss rules are immutable per session.\n75\t\n76\t---\n77\t\n78\t## The Four-Tier Signal Architecture\n79\t\n80\tSystem operates on four distinct signal tiers, each with different lead time, reliability, and processing approach:\n81\t\n82\t**Tier 1 — Hard Data (deterministic):** prices, volumes, fundamentals, foreign flow, macro indicators. Zero LLM, pure code. Lead time: hours-days.\n83\t\n84\t**Tier 2 — Official Narrative (semi-structured):** mainstream financial news, broker reports, official company disclosures, government announcements. LLM extracts claims + classifies sentiment + detects contradictions. Lead time: real-time.\n85\t\n86\t**Tier 3 — Influence Network (semi-structured):** YouTube channels, Facebook KOL pages, Telegram channels, podcasts. LLM transcribes + extracts recommendations + tags entities. Calibration database tracks each KOL's accuracy over time. Lead time: can lead by days.\n87\t\n88\t**Tier 4 — Crowd Sentiment & Pump Detection (unstructured):** community forums, public chat groups, comments. LLM classifies sentiment + detects coordinated posting + identifies pump narratives + tracks narrative lifecycle phase. Lead time: typically lags price (signals exhaustion).\n89\t\n90\tThe combination — when Tier 1+2+3 agree before Tier 4 heats up = early opportunity; when Tier 4 hot but Tier 1+2 don't support = likely top — is the core analytical edge.\n91\t\n92\tSee `specs/tier1-strategic/001-four-tier-signal-architecture.md` for detailed tier specs.\n93\t\n94\t---\n95\t\n96\t## First Sub-Scope (locked 6 months)\n97\t\n98\t**Vietnam stocks listed on HOSE/HNX/UPCoM**, specifically:\n99\t- VN30 + mid-cap (vốn hóa 2,000-50,000 tỷ VND) for primary coverage\n100\t- Long-only equity strategies (no derivatives, no shorting)\n101\t- Holding periods: 1-month minimum, 6-24 month preferred\n102\t- Position sizing per stock: 5-15% of portfolio\n103\t\n104\tOut of scope (Year 1): derivatives, warrants (CW), short selling, cryptocurrency, fund products, foreign markets, day trading, automated execution.\n105\t\n106\t---\n107\t\n108\t## Honest Boundaries (what system does NOT do)\n109\t\n110\t- **Predict price** — system predicts narrative phase, money flow direction, mispricing level. Never a price target with false precision.\n111\t- **Replace fundamental research** — surfaces opportunities, user must verify thesis before acting.\n112\t- **Execute trades** — pure research/alert tool. Execution stays manual.\n113\t- **Provide licensed financial advice** — personal research aid only. Output explicitly framed as \"thesis exploration\", not \"buy/sell recommendation\".\n114\t- **Time the market precisely** — works on phase identification (early/mid/late), not on tick-level timing.\n115\t- **Insider information** — uses only public sources. No paid leaks, no insider channels, no anything that crosses legal/ethical lines.\n116\t\n117\t---\n118\t\n119\t## Success Criteria\n120\t\n121\t**Month 3 (end of Phase 1 — Foundation):**\n122\t- Tier 1 + 2 data pipeline operational for VN30\n123\t- 50 companies have basic dossier in wiki\n124\t- First 5 thesis recorded with formal structure\n125\t- Can run /thesis-validate on a stock end-to-end in <5 minutes\n126\t\n127\t**Month 6 (end of Phase 2 — Edge Sources):**\n128\t- 30+ KOL channels tracked, calibration database has >100 recommendations with outcomes pending\n129\t- Tier 3 + 4 ingestion operational for top 100 stocks\n130\t- First detectable pump pattern caught (warning issued before public dump)\n131\t- 20+ thesis logged, first 5 hit 3-month review\n132\t\n133\t**Month 9 (end of Phase 3 — Multi-perspective):**\n134\t- Bear/bull/critic/quant/macro/behavior agents operational\n135\t- Pattern library has 15+ Vietnam-specific patterns with outcome data\n136\t- Personal bias log shows 3+ identified biases\n137\t- Thesis hit rate measurable (statistically meaningful sample)\n138\t\n139\t**Month 12 (end of Phase 4 — Compounding):**\n140\t- Karpathy outer loop optimizing signal weights weekly\n141\t- Cross-validation: system suggestions vs my manual analysis = where do they diverge?\n142\t- 3-5 trusted peers using it, providing feedback\n143\t- Demonstrable alpha vs VN-Index on dogfood portfolio (or honest accounting of why not)\n144\t\n145\t**Ultimate signal of success**: When my gut says \"buy XYZ\", I check what StockForge says first — and seriously consider it when it disagrees.\n146\t\n147\t---\n148\t\n149\t## Technical Foundation (locked Phase 1-3)\n150\t\n151\t**Stack:**\n152\t- **Python primary** — for data science, LLM workflows, time-series, backtesting (heavier than IdeaForge which was TS-primary)\n153\t- **Postgres 16 + TimescaleDB + pgvector + pg_trgm** — single DB for time-series + relational + vector\n154\t- **Redis** — cache + pub/sub + queue broker\n155\t- **Cloudflare R2** — raw content storage (PDFs, transcripts, scraped pages)\n156\t- **Claude API primary** — Sonnet for most tasks, Opus for thesis synthesis\n157\t- **OpenAI embeddings** — text-embedding-3-small (Vietnamese acceptable)\n158\t- **NestJS** — only if/when we need a public-facing API (Phase 4+)\n159\t- **Streamlit/Next.js** — Streamlit for personal dashboard (Phase 1-2), Next.js if SaaS path\n160\t- **Apache Airflow / Prefect** — data pipeline orchestration\n161\t\n162\t**Architecture:**\n163\t- Clean Architecture with DDD tactical patterns (same as IdeaForge)\n164\t- 9 bounded contexts (see `agent-workspace/constitution/architecture.md`)\n165\t- Event-driven for cross-context communication\n166\t- Multi-loop execution (Karpathy outer + Continuous middle + Per-stock inner)\n167\t\n168\t**Development approach:**\n169\t- AI-first: Claude Code as primary builder, human as spec author + reviewer + bias-checker\n170\t- Spec-Driven (SDD) + Domain-Driven (DDD) + selective BDD\n171\t- Sandwich pattern (Architect → Dev → Verifier) from Day 1\n172\t- Verify-Before-Write (VBW) protocol mandatory\n173\t- Three-tier quality gates (deterministic / probabilistic / human)\n174\t\n175\t---\n176\t\n177\t## Data Sources (Tier 1 budget)\n178\t\n179\t**Free/cheap (Phase 1):**\n180\t- vnstock (open source) — historical EOD, fundamentals\n181\t- Vietstock public — financial reports\n182\t- TCBS API — semi-public market data\n183\t- CafeF, NDH, VietnamBiz — news scraping\n184\t- Public YouTube channels — transcript via yt-dlp + Whisper\n185\t- Public Facebook fanpages — selective scraping (legal grey, careful scope)\n186\t\n187\t**Paid (Phase 2-3 if budget allows):**\n188\t- FiinPro Platform — comprehensive fundamental data (~30-100M VND/year)\n189\t- Wichart — pre-cleaned data\n190\t- SSI FastConnect — realtime quotes if needed\n191\t\n192\t**Budget cap Year 1**: 50M VND for data + LLM combined.\n193\t\n194\t---\n195\t\n196\t## Meta-Discipline\n197\t\n198\tThese charter principles override daily decisions:\n199\t\n200\t- **When in doubt, simplify** — minimum code that solves the problem, nothing speculative\n201\t- **Ship thin slices, not perfect systems** — each phase ends with something I actually use\n202\t- **Document what you learn, not what you plan** — post-mortem > prospective docs\n203\t- **Dogfood or delete** — features I don't use weekly get removed\n204\t- **Calibrate, don't guess** — every confidence claim must have outcome tracking\n205\t- **Stay agnostic about commercial outcome** — build for the craft, not for the exit\n206\t\n207\t---\n208\t\n209\t## Revision Protocol\n210\t\n211\tThis charter changes only when:\n212\t- A core principle proves materially wrong through 30+ hours of real use\n213\t- Scope demonstrably needs revision based on accumulated dogfood data\n214\t- Technical foundation invalidated by external event (tool deprecation, regulatory change, etc.)\n215\t\n216\tCharter revisions require:\n217\t- Written rationale with evidence (linked to specific sessions/post-mortems)\n218\t- 48-hour cool-down before committing change\n219\t- Explicit version bump (v1.0 → v2.0)\n220\t\n221\tMinor clarifications go in `agent-workspace/memory/agent-notes.md`. This charter stays stable.\n222\t\n223\t---\n224\t\n225\t## Document Index\n226\t\n227\t| Document | Purpose | Stability |\n228\t|---|---|---|\n229\t| `PROJECT_CHARTER.md` (this) | Vision + principles | Immutable for ~3 months |\n230\t| `AGENT_OPERATING_MANUAL.md` | Agent configs, skills, workflows | Living, frequent updates |\n231\t| `SPEC_TEMPLATE.md` | How to write specs | Stable |\n232\t| `specs/tier1-strategic/001-four-tier-signal-architecture.md` | Strategic: signal architecture | Stable |\n233\t| `specs/tier2-feature/001-validate-investment-thesis.md` | First implementation spec | Stable |\n234\t| `specs/tier2-feature/002-influence-network-tracking.md` | KOL tracking system spec | Stable |\n235\t| `specs/tier2-feature/003-crowd-sentiment-pump-detection.md` | Pump detection spec | Stable |\n236\t| `specs/tier2-feature/004-multi-perspective-adversarial-agents.md` | Adversarial analysis spec | Stable |\n237\t| `specs/tier2-feature/005-karpathy-outer-loop.md` | Pipeline self-optimization spec | Stable |\n238\t| `agent-workspace/memory/project.md` | Current state | Continuously updated |\n239\t| `agent-workspace/memory/agent-notes.md` | Learned rules | Append-mostly |\n240\t| `agent-workspace/memory/thesis-log/` | All thesis ever recorded | Append-only |\n241\t| `agent-workspace/memory/post-mortems/` | Thesis outcome reviews | Append-only |\n242\t| `agent-workspace/calibration/` | KOL accuracy, signal calibration data | Continuously updated |\n243\t\n244\t---\n245\t\n246\t## Anti-Charter (what we explicitly reject)\n247\t\n248\tTo stay focused, we reject these tempting paths:\n249\t\n250\t- **Predict prices with ML models** — models trained on VN price data overfit; no edge there.\n251\t- **Compete with broker research** — we have less data, less staff. We win on integration + edge sources, not on raw analysis depth.\n252\t- **Build for general retail public** — we build for ourselves and 3-5 peers. Mass market needs hand-holding we won't provide.\n253\t- **Trust LLM for numbers** — every numerical output must come from code with traceable inputs.\n254\t- **Build features without dogfooding** — speculative features die fast in this project.\n255\t- **Optimize for backtest performance** — Goodhart's Law is real. We optimize for forward decision quality.\n256\t- **Make money fast** — this is a 24-month project minimum to reach edge. Raw data is sacred.\n\n5. **Pattern transfer + local adaptation** — global setups (cyclical bottom, dividend value, GARP) + Vietnam-specific overlays (policy timing, foreign flow, narrative phase).\n\n6. **Human-in-loop is the product** — augment thinking, never replace it. System should challenge user's gut instinct without overriding it.\n\n7. **Dogfood mandatory** — if I don't use it weekly for real decisions, the feature gets killed. Self-use is the only validation that matters in Year 1.\n\n8. **Calibration over confidence** — system tracks its own accuracy across signal types, never claims confidence it hasn't earned through hit rate.\n\n9. **No LLM math** — LLM never generates numbers. All calculations through deterministic code with verified data inputs. LLM only interprets.\n\n10. **Position sizing & risk management are deterministic** — code-enforced rules, LLM cannot override. Maximum position size, sector concentration, stop loss rules are immutable per session.\n\n---\n\n## The Four-Tier Signal Architecture\n\nSystem operates on four distinct signal tiers, each with different lead time, reliability, and processing approach:\n\n**Tier 1 — Hard Data (deterministic):** prices, volumes, fundamentals, foreign flow, macro indicators. Zero LLM, pure code. Lead time: hours-days.\n\n**Tier 2 — Official Narrative (semi-structured):** mainstream financial news, broker reports, official company disclosures, government announcements. LLM extracts claims + classifies sentiment + detects contradictions. Lead time: real-time.\n\n**Tier 3 — Influence Network (semi-structured):** YouTube channels, Facebook KOL pages, Telegram channels, podcasts. LLM transcribes + extracts recommendations + tags entities. Calibration database tracks each KOL's accuracy over time. Lead time: can lead by days.\n\n**Tier 4 — Crowd Sentiment & Pump Detection (unstructured):** community forums, public chat groups, comments. LLM classifies sentiment + detects coordinated posting + identifies pump narratives + tracks narrative lifecycle phase. Lead time: typically lags price (signals exhaustion).\n\nThe combination — when Tier 1+2+3 agree before Tier 4 heats up = early opportunity; when Tier 4 hot but Tier 1+2 don't support = likely top — is the core analytical edge.\n\nSee `specs/tier1-strategic/001-four-tier-signal-architecture.md` for detailed tier specs.\n\n---\n\n## First Sub-Scope (locked 6 months)\n\n**Vietnam stocks listed on HOSE/HNX/UPCoM**, specifically:\n- VN30 + mid-cap (vốn hóa 2,000-50,000 tỷ VND) for primary coverage\n- Long-only equity strategies (no derivatives, no shorting)\n- Holding periods: 1-month minimum, 6-24 month preferred\n- Position sizing per stock: 5-15% of portfolio\n\nOut of scope (Year 1): derivatives, warrants (CW), short selling, cryptocurrency, fund products, foreign markets, day trading, automated execution.\n\n---\n\n## Honest Boundaries (what system does NOT do)\n\n- **Predict price** — system predicts narrative phase, money flow direction, mispricing level. Never a price target with false precision.\n- **Replace fundamental research** — surfaces opportunities, user must verify thesis before acting.\n- **Execute trades** — pure research/alert tool. Execution stays manual.\n- **Provide licensed financial advice** — personal research aid only. Output explicitly framed as \"thesis exploration\", not \"buy/sell recommendation\".\n- **Time the market precisely** — works on phase identification (early/mid/late), not on tick-level timing.\n- **Insider information** — uses only public sources. No paid leaks, no insider channels, no anything that crosses legal/ethical lines.\n\n---\n\n## Success Criteria\n\n**Month 3 (end of Phase 1 — Foundation):**\n- Tier 1 + 2 data pipeline operational for VN30\n- 50 companies have basic dossier in wiki\n- First 5 thesis recorded with formal structure\n- Can run /thesis-validate on a stock end-to-end in <5 minutes\n\n**Month 6 (end of Phase 2 — Edge Sources):**\n- 30+ KOL channels tracked, calibration database has >100 recommendations with outcomes pending\n- Tier 3 + 4 ingestion operational for top 100 stocks\n- First detectable pump pattern caught (warning issued before public dump)\n- 20+ thesis logged, first 5 hit 3-month review\n\n**Month 9 (end of Phase 3 — Multi-perspective):**\n- Bear/bull/critic/quant/macro/behavior agents operational\n- Pattern library has 15+ Vietnam-specific patterns with outcome data\n- Personal bias log shows 3+ identified biases\n- Thesis hit rate measurable (statistically meaningful sample)\n\n**Month 12 (end of Phase 4 — Compounding):**\n- Karpathy outer loop optimizing signal weights weekly\n- Cross-validation: system suggestions vs my manual analysis = where do they diverge?\n- 3-5 trusted peers using it, providing feedback\n- Demonstrable alpha vs VN-Index on dogfood portfolio (or honest accounting of why not)\n\n**Ultimate signal of success**: When my gut says \"buy XYZ\", I check what StockForge says first — and seriously consider it when it disagrees.\n\n---\n\n## Technical Foundation (locked Phase 1-3)\n\n**Stack:**\n- **Python primary** — for data science, LLM workflows, time-series, backtesting (heavier than IdeaForge which was TS-primary)\n- **Postgres 16 + TimescaleDB + pgvector + pg_trgm** — single DB for time-series + relational + vector\n- **Redis** — cache + pub/sub + queue broker\n- **Cloudflare R2** — raw content storage (PDFs, transcripts, scraped pages)\n- **Claude API primary** — Sonnet for most tasks, Opus for thesis synthesis\n- **OpenAI embeddings** — text-embedding-3-small (Vietnamese acceptable)\n- **NestJS** — only if/when we need a public-facing API (Phase 4+)\n- **Streamlit/Next.js** — Streamlit for personal dashboard (Phase 1-2), Next.js if SaaS path\n- **Apache Airflow / Prefect** — data pipeline orchestration\n\n**Architecture:**\n- Clean Architecture with DDD tactical patterns (same as IdeaForge)\n- 9 bounded contexts (see `agent-workspace/constitution/architecture.md`)\n- Event-driven for cross-context communication\n- Multi-loop execution (Karpathy outer + Continuous middle + Per-stock inner)\n\n**Development approach:**\n- AI-first: Claude Code as primary builder, human as spec author + reviewer + bias-checker\n- Spec-Driven (SDD) + Domain-Driven (DDD) + selective BDD\n- Sandwich pattern (Architect → Dev → Verifier) from Day 1\n- Verify-Before-Write (VBW) protocol mandatory\n- Three-tier quality gates (deterministic / probabilistic / human)\n\n---\n\n## Data Sources (Tier 1 budget)\n\n**Free/cheap (Phase 1):**\n- vnstock (open source) — historical EOD, fundamentals\n- Vietstock public — financial reports\n- TCBS API — semi-public market data\n- CafeF, NDH, VietnamBiz — news scraping\n- Public YouTube channels — transcript via yt-dlp + Whisper\n- Public Facebook fanpages — selective scraping (legal grey, careful scope)\n\n**Paid (Phase 2-3 if budget allows):**\n- FiinPro Platform — comprehensive fundamental data (~30-100M VND/year)\n- Wichart — pre-cleaned data\n- SSI FastConnect — realtime quotes if needed\n\n**Budget cap Year 1**: 50M VND for data + LLM combined.\n\n---\n\n## Meta-Discipline\n\nThese charter principles override daily decisions:\n\n- **When in doubt, simplify** — minimum code that solves the problem, nothing speculative\n- **Ship thin slices, not perfect systems** — each phase ends with something I actually use\n- **Document what you learn, not what you plan** — post-mortem > prospective docs\n- **Dogfood or delete** — features I don't use weekly get removed\n- **Calibrate, don't guess** — every confidence claim must have outcome tracking\n- **Stay agnostic about commercial outcome** — build for the craft, not for the exit\n\n---\n\n## Revision Protocol\n\nThis charter changes only when:\n- A core principle proves materially wrong through 30+ hours of real use\n- Scope demonstrably needs revision based on accumulated dogfood data\n- Technical foundation invalidated by external event (tool deprecation, regulatory change, etc.)\n\nCharter revisions require:\n- Written rationale with evidence (linked to specific sessions/post-mortems)\n- 48-hour cool-down before committing change\n- Explicit version bump (v1.0 → v2.0)\n\nMinor clarifications go in `agent-workspace/memory/agent-notes.md`. This charter stays stable.\n\n---\n\n## Document Index\n\n| Document | Purpose | Stability |\n|---|---|---|\n| `PROJECT_CHARTER.md` (this) | Vision + principles | Immutable for ~3 months |\n| `AGENT_OPERATING_MANUAL.md` | Agent configs, skills, workflows | Living, frequent updates |\n| `SPEC_TEMPLATE.md` | How to write specs | Stable |\n| `specs/tier1-strategic/001-four-tier-signal-architecture.md` | Strategic: signal architecture | Stable |\n| `specs/tier2-feature/001-validate-investment-thesis.md` | First implementation spec | Stable |\n| `specs/tier2-feature/002-influence-network-tracking.md` | KOL tracking system spec | Stable |\n| `specs/tier2-feature/003-crowd-sentiment-pump-detection.md` | Pump detection spec | Stable |\n| `specs/tier2-feature/004-multi-perspective-adversarial-agents.md` | Adversarial analysis spec | Stable |\n| `specs/tier2-feature/005-karpathy-outer-loop.md` | Pipeline self-optimization spec | Stable |\n| `agent-workspace/memory/project.md` | Current state | Continuously updated |\n| `agent-workspace/memory/agent-notes.md` | Learned rules | Append-mostly |\n| `agent-workspace/memory/thesis-log/` | All thesis ever recorded | Append-only |\n| `agent-workspace/memory/post-mortems/` | Thesis outcome reviews | Append-only |\n| `agent-workspace/calibration/` | KOL accuracy, signal calibration data | Continuously updated |\n\n---\n\n## Anti-Charter (what we explicitly reject)\n\nTo stay focused, we reject these tempting paths:\n\n- **Predict prices with ML models** — models trained on VN price data overfit; no edge there.\n- **Compete with broker research** — we have less data, less staff. We win on integration + edge sources, not on raw analysis depth.\n- **Build for general retail public** — we build for ourselves and 3-5 peers. Mass market needs hand-holding we won't provide.\n- **Trust LLM for numbers** — every numerical output must come from code with traceable inputs.\n- **Build features without dogfooding** — speculative features die fast in this project.\n- **Optimize for backtest performance** — Goodhart's Law is real. We optimize for forward decision quality.\n- **Make money fast** — this is a 24-month project minimum to reach edge. Quick wins are anti-pattern.\n","numLines":257,"startLine":1,"totalLines":257}},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"ae6433b5-488f-4327-92c1-b58b4ae56836","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"C:\\htdocs\\stockforge","sessionId":"040b98a4-76e6-42d6-8df9-28986cf96d89","version":"2.1.124","gitBranch":"main"}

Everything here represents **agent state, decisions, plans, observations, learning**. Agents WRITE here freely (within constitution rules); humans READ here but normally do not edit.\n\nThis separation exists to prevent two failure modes from orch:\n1. **Charter drift via shared-workspace mutation** (orch CF-DOGFOOD-2)\n2. **Human cognitive overload from dense session logs** (UP02 §1.3 — \"human đối mặt hàng chục spec/document quá tải nếu không sắp xếp khoa học\")\n\nThe agent owns this directory but must keep it AUDITABLE — every artifact provenance-linked, every decision sourced.\n\n---\n\n## Subdirectories\n\n| Path | Purpose | Lifecycle |\n|---|---|---|\n| `constitution/` | **IMMUTABLE without explicit user approval**. Charter-tier rules (autonomous-protocol, model-routing, identity-scope, etc.). Track 7 produces drafts in `proposals/`; user explicit approve to move here. | Edit denied by .claude/settings.json; Write only via human approval gate |\n| `memory/project.md` | High-level project state; phase tracker; ADRs (last 5). Update on phase boundaries + architectural decisions. | Long-lived; trim to most recent decisions |\n| `memory/current-execution.md` | **THE single routing source of truth**. Active phase + active session + autonomous_mode flag + routing table. Read FIRST every session. | Long-lived; updated each session boundary |\n| `memory/agent-notes.md` | Learned rules from real experience (post-mortem / drift / user correction). Append-only mostly. | Long-lived |\n| `memory/decisions/` | Sequential ADRs (`NNN-<slug>.md`) + `_template.md` + `README.md` index. 12-field schema (Track 2). | Append-only; supersession via status field |\n| `memory/sessions/` | One file per session: `YYYY-MM-DD-session-N.md`. What happened, decisions made, files touched. | Append-only |\n| `memory/observations/` | Subagent return artifacts (per Track 6 spec). Each subagent writes one observation file describing what it did. | Append; cleaned periodically by aggregator |\n| `memory/checkpoints/` | Session handoff state for self-reboot (Track 5). `latest.md` is canonical pointer; timestamped historical files retained. | Append + latest.md updated each checkpoint |\n| `memory/patterns-discovered/` | Pattern mining outputs (Track 0 — DONE) + ongoing pattern catalog. | Append; significant patterns promoted to constitution |\n| `memory/drift-logs/` | Drift-check (DR1-DR12) results; runs on hook + on-demand. | Time-series append |\n| `memory/post-mortems/` | After significant failure or thesis-revoked event: what failed, root cause, prevention rule. | Append |\n| `memory/thesis-log/` | Stock-domain thesis exploration entries. Read-only for IMPL sessions. | Append + revisited per calibration |\n| `memory/sync-tracker/` | Track 8a output: Confidence Score SQLite + weights.yaml + auto-rendered `_index.md`. | Live updated by hooks |\n| `memory/self-awareness/` | Track 9 output: model × effort × thinking profile cards + known-issues + best-practices. | Live updated by Stop-hook aggregator |\n| `memory/mistake-log.md` | Track 7 deliverable: structured failure catalog. What went wrong / Root cause / Prevention rule / Severity. | Append; pre-flight read by all agents |\n| `session-plans/pending/` | Plans authored, awaiting execution. Phase 0 plan lives here. | Move to `completed/` when done |\n| `session-plans/completed/` | Executed plans; archived for reference + retrospective input. | Append |\n| `quality-reports/{deterministic,probabilistic,drift-reports}/` | Tier-1/2/3 gate outputs (CLAUDE.md § Quality Gates). | Per-run files |\n| `ubiquitous-language/` | DDD glossary + domain-mapping + drift-log. Stockforge stock-domain vocabulary. | Append; canonical via `/drill-me` |\n| `calibration/` | Empirical hit-rate data per signal type. Confidence claims MUST trace here (CLAUDE.md hard rule). | Append per thesis post-mortem |\n| `research/` | Research notes from `research-scanner` subagent dispatches (e.g., reference-repo studies). | Append |\n\n---\n\n## Contract Rules (BINDING)\n\n1. **Constitution is immutable absent explicit human approval.** `Edit/Write` to `agent-workspace/constitution/**` is in `.claude/settings.json` deny list. Track 7 writes constitution drafts to `proposals/`; user explicit approve moves them.\n\n2. **`memory/decisions/` is append-mostly + supersession-status.** Don't delete decisions; mark `status: superseded-by-D-NNN` to revoke. Sequential numbering (`001`, `002`, ...) — don't reuse numbers.\n\n3. **`current-execution.md` is the routing source-of-truth.** No skill, agent, or command may hardcode phase paths or session paths from memory; resolve via this file. Stale paths in CLAUDE.md or skills = anti-pattern.\n\n4. **Never edit `obsidian-vault/raw/`.** Immutable. Vault writes only to `wiki/`. (Established in stockforge CLAUDE.md.)\n\n5. **Provenance is mandatory.** Every decision file references its source (human prompt / spec clause / drift detection / agent inference). Every thesis cites source + as-of date (I-S2). Every confidence claim cites historical hit rate (I-S20-equivalent).\n\n6. **Agents never `git commit` in this directory unless user explicitly requests.** Stage only.\n\n7. **`patterns-discovered/` artifacts are READ-ONLY for production code.** Patterns must be promoted to constitution / skills / hook scripts before becoming binding. (Otherwise they're informal notes, not contracts.)\n\n---\n\n## Reading Priority for Agent\n\nPer `agent-workspace/constitution/autonomous-protocol.md` (Track 7) and stockforge `CLAUDE.md` § Session Protocol:\n\n1. **`memory/current-execution.md`** — first; resolve active track\n2. **`memory/project.md`** — project state\n3. **`memory/checkpoints/latest.md`** if a recent checkpoint exists (within last 24h) — resume context\n4. **`memory/agent-notes.md`** — learned rules\n5. **`memory/mistake-log.md`** — pre-flight failure catalog\n6. **Last 3 files in `memory/sessions/`** — recent context\n7. **`session-plans/pending/<active-plan>.md`** — current plan\n8. **Relevant constitution files** as task demands (don't load all every session)\n9. **Relevant skills + agents + commands** as task demands\n\n---\n\n## Anti-Patterns to Avoid\n\n(From `memory/patterns-discovered/SYNTHESIS.md` § 6, full catalog 23 items. Highest-priority for this directory:)\n\n- **AP-1 Same-agent self-review** — never review your own implementation; dispatch fresh-context verifier\n- **AP-2 Self-track wind-down** — `.transcript-tokens` real-transcript is authoritative, not LLM self-track\n- **AP-5 Charter-coherence defer overriding user-CRITICAL** — re-read all `user_prompt/*` at every phase entry; never silently defer USER-CRITICAL\n- **AP-7 Performative SC ticking** — defer with explicit prerequisites > fire vacuous proposals\n- **AP-8 Pre-staged work causing checkpoint drift** — update `current-execution.md` immediately on task complete, not session-end\n- **AP-17 Identity drift** — stockforge is AI-first VN stock advisory; not generic financial framework (see `constitution/identity-scope.md` once Track 7 ships)\n- **AP-23 Continuous LLM-Guardian** — deterministic hooks = Guardian; LLM Guardian only at session-end aggregation\n\n---\n\n## Connection to human-workspace/\n\nThis directory is the agent's domain. Human's domain is `human-workspace/`. The two communicate through:\n- Human → Agent: `human-workspace/user_prompt/`, `human-workspace/decisions/`\n- Agent → Human: `human-workspace/notifications/`, `human-workspace/q-and-a/pending/`\n- Bidirectional: `human-workspace/q-and-a/answered/` — agent writes pending; either human or agent (per Auto-mv rule below) moves resolved bundles to answered/\n- Audit trail: this directory's `memory/decisions/` references `human-workspace/` source files via path pointers\n\n**Auto-mv rule (HH-E.2 — D-031 ratification, 2026-05-05)**: Agent MAY mv a bundle from `q-and-a/pending/` to `q-and-a/answered/` IFF ALL of the following hold:\n\n1. **Frontmatter signal**: bundle frontmatter `status:` field value starts with one of: `answered-`, `closed-`, `resolved-`. Examples already in repo: `answered-via-chat`, `answered-via-AskUserQuestion`, `answered-2026-05-04-via-chat`. Detection is deterministic (head -20 of file + grep `^status:`).\n2. **No human-veto signal**: bundle frontmatter has NO `wait_until:` ISO-8601 timestamp greater than current epoch — if present, agent MUST defer mv until that timestamp passes. The `Write` tool overwrites; the `Edit` tool surgical-replaces. Tool-level Read-before-Write blocker DOES NOT FIRE if file was Read at any offset earlier in session — partial reads bypass the safety. Result: M-S45-1 destroyed ~140 LOC of agent-notes.md (lines 315..454 unrecoverable) when sandwich-architect called `Write` on agent-notes thinking they were appending.\n55\t\n56\t**Detection mechanism**: PreToolUse hook intercepts `Write` events; if `tool_input.file_path` matches protected-paths regex AND file already exists on disk → HARD-BLOCK with stderr explanation pointing to L-S45-2.\n57\t\n58\t**Status**: ✅ ALREADY-APPLIED — `scripts/hooks/write-vs-edit-guard.sh` (3524 bytes) shipped 2026-05-05 07:57 same-turn as the M-S45-1 incident; wired in `.claude/settings.json` PreToolUse chain; 4/4 smoke-test green per M-S45-1 § Where applied.\n59\t\n60\t**Proposed extension** (this cycle adds): companion firing-test `scripts/hooks/firing-tests/write-vs-edit-guard-fire-test.sh` per Phase 3.5 Hard Rule #2 + L-S51-1 discipline. Real session-data shape: PreToolUse JSON envelope with `tool_input.file_path` field.\n61\t\n62\t**Promotion target priority**: priority-1 hook (already ✅) + priority-1 firing-test (NEW this cycle).\n63\t\n64\t**Cheapest-first justification**: hook tier is the only level that can mechanically prevent the failure mode (LLM-judgment-tier guidance has already been violated 3+ times per L-S44-1 / M-S45-2 / M-S47-1 self-pause family — same pattern of \"doctrine without enforcement gets violated\"). Skill or charter would not block the destructive call.\n65\t\n66\t---\n67\t\n68\t### Cluster 2: Checkpoint-write IS session-boundary marker — PARTIAL-APPLIED + STRICT-MODE PROMOTION CANDIDATE\n69\t\n70\t**Member entries** (≥3): L-S49b-3, L-S49b-4, M-S49b-2 (REFRAMED PRIMARY root cause)\n71\t\n72\t**Common pattern**: Writing/Editing `agent-workspace/memory/checkpoints/latest.md` is the session-boundary contract. The `next_action` field in the checkpoint is meant to be read by the NEXT session in fresh-context handoff — NOT executed by the current turn. M-S49b-2 incident: prior session 5b96635e wrote checkpoint with `next_action: dispatch sandwich-verifier`, then dispatched sandwich-verifier in same turn, then ran Bash tier1 final-check, then wrote summary. User had typed `/new` mid-turn; v2.1.124 queued the slash command; LLM ignored the queue. New session opened with stale checkpoint; almost re-dispatched. Background agent killed mid-investigation; observation lost.\n73\t\n74\t**Detection mechanism**: PostToolUse hook gates on Edit/Write to `checkpoints/latest.md`; emits marker file `agent-workspace/memory/.checkpoint-written-<session_id>` with timestamp; companion watchdog checks subsequent tool calls within same session — if Edit/Write/Agent/Bash fires AFTER marker, emit drift-signal severity HIGH \"L-S49b-4 carve-out violated\".\n75\t\n76\t**Status**: ⚠️ PARTIAL-APPLIED — `scripts/hooks/checkpoint-write-end-turn-watchdog.sh` (3923 bytes; 2026-05-05 18:17) + `scripts/hooks/checkpoint-write-marker.sh` + `scripts/hooks/checkpoint-marker-cleanup-resume.sh` ALL EXIST in scripts/hooks/ Glob (cross-ref Phase 3.5 plan 010 § T4.2). Real file-format detection: `.session-hooks.log` line pattern `PostToolUse session=<id> tool=Edit file=.../checkpoints/latest.md` + subsequent line `PostToolUse session=<id> tool=Bash` within same session.\n79\t\n80\t**Cheapest-first justification**: HOOK exists (good defense-in-depth); CHARTER promote needed because pattern is identity-shaping (defines fresh-context-handoff contract). Per Q-E3 closed cadence: hook FIRST (done), then charter-LAST (Phase 3.5 T4/T8 schedule).\n81\t\n82\t---\n83\t\n84\t### Cluster 3: Dispatch state inference — pre-dispatch in-flight check + post-/clear artifact verify (NEW HOOK CANDIDATE)\n85\t\n86\t**Member entries** (≥3): L-S45-1 (pre-staged file VBW), L-S46-2 (post-/clear TaskList loss), L-S49b-3 (background-subagent dispatch sequencing), M-S49b-2 (REFRAMED — secondary observation S1 + S2)\n87\t\n88\t**Common pattern**: Indirect signals (TaskList state, /clear effects, stale checkpoint `next_action`) lead LLM to infer wrong dispatch state and re-execute completed work. Three sub-patterns:\n89\t1. Pre-staged file artifact: prior dispatch shipped already; new dispatch fires and Glob misses → LLM thinks file absent → attempts Write → near-miss data loss (L-S45-1).\n90\t2. Post-/clear TaskList loss: empty TaskList misread as \"dispatch killed\"; redundant re-dispatch burns ~150K tokens (L-S46-2).\n91\t3. Stale checkpoint next_action: post-/clear LLM reads `next_action` and prepares re-dispatch unaware of in-flight state (M-S49b-2 secondary).\n92\t\n93\t**Detection mechanism**: SessionStart hook scans (a) `current-execution.md` for \"IN-PROGRESS\" rows older than 1hr → cross-checks with expected session log via Glob; if log exists, emit ALERT \"may already be COMPLETE; verify before re-dispatch\"; (b) `agent-workspace/memory/.dispatch-pending-*.jsonl` for `state=pending` rows older than 2hr → cross-checks with expected observation file path; if absent + age > 2hr, emit ALERT \"stale pending dispatch — verify before any new dispatch\"; (c) `agent-workspace/{memory/decisions,session-plans/pending}/` for files created within last 24h matching active-session-id (pre-staged artifacts).\n94\t\n95\t**Status**: 🔴 NO SHIPPED HOOK — closest existing hook is `dispatch-jsonl-recorder.sh` (records dispatches but doesn't surveil stale entries). L-S49b-3 explicitly proposes `scripts/hooks/in-flight-subagent-watcher.sh` as deferred Fix-L4. M-S49b-2 § Prevention Rules SECONDARY also lists this hook.\n96\t\n97\t**Proposed promotion**: priority-1 NEW HOOK — `scripts/hooks/in-flight-subagent-watcher.sh` (UserPromptSubmit + SessionStart hook).\n98\t\n99\t**Hook design**:\n100\t- **Trigger event**: UserPromptSubmit (cheap surveillance every prompt) + SessionStart (resume/clear chain)\n101\t- **Real file format hook detects against**:\n102\t  - `agent-workspace/memory/.dispatch-pending-S<NN>-current.jsonl` — sample format from current checkpoint:\n103\t    ```json\n104\t    {\"state\":\"pending\",\"tool_use_id\":\"toolu_01JLqZBE...\",\"ts_ms\":1714940000000,\"parent_session_id\":\"5b96635e-...\"}\n105\t    ```\n106\t  - `agent-workspace/memory/observations/promote-rule-S*.md` — observation Glob target\n107\t  - `agent-workspace/memory/checkpoints/latest.md` — read `in_flight_subagent_dispatch:` YAML block\n108\t- **Detection script** (~50 LOC bash, POSIX per L-S11-1):\n109\t  ```bash\n110\t  set -uo pipefail\n111\t  trap 'exit 0' ERR\n112\t  PROJECT_DIR=\"${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}\"\n113\t  PENDING_GLOB=\"$PROJECT_DIR/agent-workspace/memory/.dispatch-pending-*.jsonl\"\n114\t  OBS_DIR=\"$PROJECT_DIR/agent-workspace/memory/observations\"\n115\t  NOW_S=$(date +%s)\n116\t  AGE_THRESHOLD_S=7200  # 2 hours\n117\t  STALE_COUNT=0\n118\t  for f in $PENDING_GLOB; do\n119\t    [ -f \"$f\" ] || continue\n120\t    while IFS= read -r line; do\n121\t      state=$(echo \"$line\" | grep -oE '\"state\":\"[a-z]+\"' | head -1 | sed 's/.*\"state\":\"//;s/\"//' || echo \"\")\n122\t      [ \"$state\" = \"pending\" ] || continue\n123\t      ts_ms=$(echo \"$line\" | grep -oE '\"ts_ms\":[0-9]+' | head -1 | sed 's/.*://' || echo 0)\n124\t      ts_s=$((ts_ms / 1000))\n125\t      age_s=$((NOW_S - ts_s))\n126\t      [ \"$age_s\" -lt \"$AGE_THRESHOLD_S\" ] && continue\n127\t      expected=$(echo \"$line\" | grep -oE '\"expected_observation_path\":\"[^\"]+\"' | head -1 | sed 's/.*://;s/\"//g' || echo \"\")\n128\t      [ -n \"$expected\" ] && [ -f \"$PROJECT_DIR/$expected\" ] && continue  # observation arrived\n129\t      STALE_COUNT=$((STALE_COUNT + 1))\n130\t      printf 'STALE PENDING DISPATCH: ts_age=%ss expected=%s\\n' \"$age_s\" \"$expected\" >&2\n131\t    done < \"$f\"\n132\t  done\n133\t  [ \"$STALE_COUNT\" -gt 0 ] && \\\n134\t    echo \"in-flight-subagent-watcher: $STALE_COUNT stale pending dispatch(es) — verify state before any new Agent.dispatch\" >&2\n135\t  exit 0\n136\t  ```\n137\t- **Companion firing-test strategy**: synthesize 3 inputs:\n138\t  1. `.dispatch-pending-test1.jsonl` with `state=pending`, `ts_ms` = (now - 10000) ms (fresh) → assert NO alert\n139\t  2. `.dispatch-pending-test2.jsonl` with `state=pending`, `ts_ms` = (now - 8000000) ms (stale, >2hr), `expected_observation_path` = nonexistent file → assert ALERT fires\n140\t  3. `.dispatch-pending-test3.jsonl` with same stale ts but `expected_observation_path` = existing file → assert NO alert (observation arrived)\n141\t- **Severity emitted**: medium (advisory; LLM checks before next dispatch).\n142\t\n143\t**Cheapest-first justification**: HOOK is the right level — pattern is mechanically detectable via JSONL parse + file existence. SKILL would burn LLM cost on trivial check every prompt. Charter would over-codify a defense-in-depth tool.\n144\t\n145\t---\n146\t\n147\t### Cluster 4: Self-pause / Mode-E recurrence detector incompleteness — ALREADY-APPLIED HOOK + REGEX EXTENSION CANDIDATE\n148\t\n149\t**Member entries** (≥3): L-S44-1 (initial — Holding here / next session's job), M-S45-2 (1st miss — wait for your call), M-S47-1 (2nd miss — Next 'continue' enters Sxx)\n150\t\n151\t**Common pattern**: Self-pause family. LLM ends turn with phrasing that defers next action to user/next-session/Stop-hook even in autonomous-full mode. Detector regex in `scripts/hooks/autonomous-stop-watchdog.sh` evolves reactively — each new sub-pattern slips past prior regex; M-S45-2 added \"wait for your\" / \"deferring to\" / \"standing by\"; M-S47-1 added 4 routing-branch alternations (\"Next continue enters/triggers/fires\"). **3 recurrences post-detector-deployed** — Q-E3 promotion cadence threshold for Hook-extended-twice → next escalation is Skill or Charter at 4th recurrence.\n152\t\n153\t**Detection mechanism**: post-Stop hook scans last assistant text via `LAST_TAIL` against SELF_PAUSE_HIT regex; emits `.autonomous-self-pause-alert.log` with session_id + tokens.\n154\t\n155\t**Status**: ✅ ALREADY-APPLIED — `scripts/hooks/autonomous-stop-watchdog.sh` § 3 + § 4b regex extended at S44 + S45 + S47. ⚠️ Per post-mortem 2026-05-05 § HH-D table: HH-D Mode-E detector reports \"0 firings of any 'mode-e' or 'self-pause' or 'defection' detector in `.session-hooks.log` last 7 days\" — i.e., either the detector is genuinely catching all phrasings (no recurrences) OR the detector trace channel is opaque.\n156\t\n157\t**Proposed promotion**: priority-1 — RETROFIT firing-test for `autonomous-stop-watchdog.sh` per L-S51-1 discipline. The detector has been extended 3 times and we have NO firing-test that synthesizes the 7+ known self-pause phrasings + 4+ control phrasings (per M-S47-1 smoke-test \"5/5 self-pause caught + 4/4 controls skipped\"). Without firing-test, we cannot DEMONSTRATE the regex still catches all 3 sub-pattern families.\n158\t\n159\t**Hook design** (firing-test, not new hook):\n160\t- **Trigger event**: manual-invoke for CI; smoke-tested at hook-edit time\n161\t- **Real file format**: `LAST_TAIL` extracted from `transcript_path` JSON; sample line patterns:\n162\t  - Mode-E hits (must trigger): `Holding here. Stop hook + Mode-D handles.`, `wait for your call`, `Next 'continue' enters S52`, `S{N+1} entry is the next session's job`, `standing by`, `deferring to you`\n163\t  - Controls (must NOT trigger): `If you continue with this approach`, `Will continue running tests`, `wait for build to finish`, `Phase 3 next session = S46`\n164\t- **Detection script** (~80 LOC):\n165\t  ```bash\n166\t  #!/usr/bin/env bash\n167\t  # autonomous-stop-watchdog-fire-test.sh\n168\t  set -uo pipefail\n169\t  HOOK=\"scripts/hooks/autonomous-stop-watchdog.sh\"\n170\t  cases_pause=(\"Holding here. Stop hook handles.\" \"I'll wait for your call.\" \\\n171\t               \"Next 'continue' enters S52.\" \"deferring to you\" \"standing by\" \\\n172\t               \"S52 entry is the next session's job\" \"wait for fresh session\")\n173\t  cases_ok=(\"If you continue with this approach\" \"Will continue running tests\" \\\n174\t            \"wait for build to finish\" \"Phase 3 next session = S46\")\n175\t  PASS=0; FAIL=0\n176\t  for phrase in \"${cases_pause[@]}\"; do\n177\t    out=$(echo \"$phrase\" | bash \"$HOOK\" 2>&1 || true)\n178\t    if echo \"$out\" | grep -q \"self-pause\\|SELF_PAUSE\\|Mode-E\"; then\n179\t      PASS=$((PASS+1))\n180\t    else\n181\t      FAIL=$((FAIL+1))\n182\t      printf \"FAIL pause case: %s\\n\" \"$phrase\"\n183\t    fi\n184\t  done\n185\t  for phrase in \"${cases_ok[@]}\"; do\n186\t    out=$(echo \"$phrase\" | bash \"$HOOK\" 2>&1 || true)\n187\t    if echo \"$out\" | grep -q \"self-pause\\|SELF_PAUSE\\|Mode-E\"; then\n188\t      FAIL=$((FAIL+1))\n189\t      printf \"FAIL false-positive: %s\\n\" \"$phrase\"\n190\t    else\n191\t      PASS=$((PASS+1))\n192\t    fi\n193\t  done\n194\t  printf \"Total: PASS=%d FAIL=%d\\n\" \"$PASS\" \"$FAIL\"\n195\t  [ \"$FAIL\" -eq 0 ] && exit 0 || exit 1\n196\t  ```\n197\t- **Severity emitted**: HIGH if any pause case slips past regex; LOW if any control case false-positives.\n198\t\n199\t**Cheapest-first justification**: hook tier already extended 3 times (= mechanical layer). Skill-tier would be appropriate if 4th recurrence happens AND new failure mode is fundamentally different from regex (e.g., contextual judgment about whether phrase is autonomous-defection). Charter-tier would re-codify autonomous_continue_no_self_pause memory rule as project-binding — pending if 4th recurrence forces it.\n200\t\n201\t---\n202\t\n203\t### Cluster 5: Hook-firing empirical gap (NEW PROPOSAL — META-RULE) — PRIORITY-1 NEW HOOK\n204\t\n205\t**Member entries** (≥3): L-S51-1 (empirical-firing discipline), M-S51-1 (HH-C.4 grep pattern mismatch — fires but silently broken), L-S49b-2 (harness diagnosis playbook — when hooks \"don't seem to fire\") + post-mortem 2026-05-05-phase-2.5-empirical-firing-gap.md gap classes (a)/(b)/(c)/(d)\n206\t\n207\t**Common pattern**: Hooks may be wired + bash-syntax-clean + smoke-passing AND STILL be silently broken at the empirical-firing layer. lightweight precursor to T6's full harness-health-self-scan).\n218\t\n219\t**Hook design**:\n220\t- **Trigger event**: UserPromptSubmit (high-frequency cheap check; output via `<system-reminder>` channel)\n221\t- **Real file format hook detects against**:\n222\t  - `agent-workspace/memory/.session-hooks.log` — sample lines (verified via post-mortem grep):\n223\t    ```\n224\t    [2026-05-05T18:48:20+07:00] watchdog tokens=...\n225\t    [2026-05-05T19:03:58+07:00] SessionStart session=...\n226\t    [2026-05-05T19:12:38+07:00] Stop session=...\n227\t    [2026-05-05T19:13:00+07:00] PostToolUse session=...\n228\t    ```\n229\t  - `.claude/settings.json` — JSON with `hooks: { Stop: [...], UserPromptSubmit: [...], SessionStart: [...], PostToolUse: [...], PreToolUse: [...] }` chains; each chain entry has `hooks: [{ command: \"bash scripts/hooks/<hook-name>.sh\" }]` shape\n230\t  - `.promotion-cycle.log`, `.autonomous-stop-watchdog.log`, `.autonomous-self-pause-alert.log`, etc. — per-hook log files\n231\t- **Detection script** (~70 LOC):\n232\t  ```bash\n233\t  set -uo pipefail\n234\t  trap 'exit 0' ERR\n235\t  PROJECT_DIR=\"${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}\"\n236\t  HOOKS_LOG=\"$PROJECT_DIR/agent-workspace/memory/.session-hooks.log\"\n237\t  SETTINGS=\"$PROJECT_DIR/.claude/settings.json\"\n238\t  [ -f \"$HOOKS_LOG\" ] || exit 0\n239\t  [ -f \"$SETTINGS\" ] || exit 0\n240\t  # Extract declared hook names from settings.json (cheap-first: prefer python if available; else grep)\n241\t  declared=$(python -c \"import json,sys; d=json.load(open('$SETTINGS')); chains=d.get('hooks',{}); names=set(); \n242\t  for c in chains.values():\n243\t    for entry in c:\n244\t      for h in entry.get('hooks',[]):\n245\t        cmd=h.get('command','');\n246\t        for tok in cmd.split():\n247\t          if tok.endswith('.sh'): names.add(tok.split('/')[-1])\n248\t  print('\\n'.join(sorted(names)))\" 2>/dev/null || true)\n249\t  [ -z \"$declared\" ] && exit 0\n250\t  # 7-day window\n251\t  cutoff=$(date -d '7 days ago' +%s 2>/dev/null || date -v-7d +%s 2>/dev/null || echo 0)\n252\t  silent_count=0\n253\t  for hook_name in $declared; do\n254\t    # Map to per-hook log file IF exists; else search session-hooks.log for hook-emitted patterns\n255\t    log_file=\"$PROJECT_DIR/agent-workspace/memory/.${hook_name%.sh}.log\"\n256\t    if [ -f \"$log_file\" ]; then\n257\t      mtime=$(stat -c '%Y' \"$log_file\" 2>/dev/null || stat -f '%m' \"$log_file\" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)\n258\t      [ \"$mtime\" -gt \"$cutoff\" ] && continue\n259\t    fi\n260\t    # Also check session-hooks.log for hook-name mention\n261\t    hits=$(grep -c \"$hook_name\" \"$HOOKS_LOG\" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)\n262\t    [ \"$hits\" -gt 0 ] && continue\n263\t    silent_count=$((silent_count + 1))\n264\t    printf 'SILENT-HOOK: %s — 0 firings in last 7 days\\n' \"$hook_name\" >&2\n265\t  done\n266\t  [ \"$silent_count\" -gt 0 ] && \\\n267\t    echo \"hook-firing-counter: $silent_count declared hook(s) have 0 firings in last 7d — investigate per L-S49b-2 5-step playbook\" >&2\n268\t  exit 0\n269\t  ```\n270\t- **Companion firing-test strategy**:\n271\t  1. CHARTER (Principle 11 in T8) is targeted but operates at audit/policy level — daily-firing detection still needs a hook. **This hook is the precursor to T6's `harness-health-self-scan.sh`** (plan 010 T5 + T6); shipping a minimal version this cycle gives faster feedback while T5 protocol gets ratified.\n278\t\n279\t---\n280\t\n281\t### Cluster 6: Bash-hook authoring traps + grep-pattern-on-imagined-format anti-pattern (NEW HOOK CANDIDATE)\n282\t\n283\t**Member entries** (≥3): L-S51-1 (empirical-firing — root cause is grep-on-imagined-format), M-S51-1 (HH-C.4 grep pattern bug), L-S48d-1 (pipefail + grep-no-match silent fail), L-S48m-1 (CLAUDE_SESSION_ID env var empty on Windows — silent skip), M-S48d-1 (same as L-S48d-1 source), L-S43b-9 + L-S11-1 (referenced via S43c carry-over: bash printf, POSIX portability)\n284\t\n285\t**Common pattern**: Bash hook authors write detection logic against an IMAGINED file format instead of doing VBW protocol read of real format. Symptoms:\n286\t1. Grep pattern never matches (M-S51-1: `^\\*\\*Session N\\*\\*:` literal vs real `## S50 — ...` header)\n287\t2. Marker uses `$CLAUDE_SESSION_ID` which is empty on Windows → silent skip (L-S48m-1)\n288\t3. `set -uo pipefail` + `trap 'exit 0' ERR` + optional grep that legitimately matches nothing → ERR trap fires silently → script exits 0 → no log entry → invisible failure (L-S48d-1 / M-S48d-1)\n289\t4. `printf '-'` without `--` sentinel → printf treats hyphen-string as flag (L-S43b-9 from S43c carry-over)\n290\t5. `head -1` of unscoped grep returns wrong element (L-S11-1 / L-S43b-9 family)\n291\t\n292\t**Detection mechanism**: PreCommit/PreToolUse hook OR scheduled lint scans `scripts/hooks/*.sh` for known anti-patterns:\n293\t- pattern A (M-S51-1): `grep .* '\\^\\*\\*Session N\\*\\*:'` literal — flag for review (file format check needed)\n294\t- pattern B (L-S48m-1): `\\$\\{?CLAUDE_SESSION_ID:?-default\\}?` in marker name — flag (use session-log basename per L-S48m-1)\n295\t- pattern C (L-S48d-1): `set -.*pipefail.*` AND `trap '.*' ERR` AND `grep ` without surrounding `|| true` or `set +o pipefail` brackets — flag\n296\t- pattern D (L-S43b-9): `printf '-` or `printf \"-` without preceding `--` sentinel — flag\n297\t- pattern E (L-S11-1): `grep -oE.* | head -1` over multi-element source — flag with severity LOW\n298\t\n299\t**Status**: ⚠️ PARTIAL — `scripts/hooks/bash-hook-lint.sh` shipped per S43c S43c-C5 (printf `--` sentinel + head -1 sentinel checks per S43c § 110); needs extension for patterns A + B + C added this cycle.\n300\t\n301\t**Proposed promotion**: priority-1 — extend existing `scripts/hooks/bash-hook-lint.sh` with 3 new pattern checks (A + B + C). Estimated +30 LOC.\n302\t\n303\t**Hook design**:\n304\t- **Trigger event**: SessionStart (or weekly cron via SessionStart frequency rate-limit)\n305\t- **Real file format hook detects against**: `scripts/hooks/*.sh` — sample real lines from inspected scripts:\n306\t  - Pattern A example (just-fixed in `promotion-cycle-trigger.sh:L23` pre-fix): `grep -E '^\\*\\*Session N\\*\\*:' \"$EXEC_FILE\"` ← fixed S51 T3.1\n307\t  - Pattern B example (`profile-template-auto-populate.sh` pre-S48m fix): `MARKER=\"${MARKER_DIR}/.profile-template-fired-${CLAUDE_SESSION_ID:-default}\"` ← fixed S48m\n308\t  - Pattern C example (`profile-template-auto-populate.sh` pre-S48d fix): `set -uo pipefail; trap 'exit 0' ERR; ... grep -m1 -E '^agent:' \"$LATEST_SESSION\" | grep -oE 'claude-(opus|...)'` (no `|| true`) ← fixed S48d\n309\t- **Detection script** (~30 LOC ADD to existing bash-hook-lint.sh):\n310\t  ```bash\n311\t  # === pattern A: grep on imagined format (M-S51-1) ===\n312\t  for sh in scripts/hooks/*.sh; do\n313\t    if grep -nE 'grep .* '\\''\\^\\*\\*Session N' \"$sh\" >/dev/null; then\n314\t      printf '[A] %s: literal **Session N** grep — verify against real current-execution.md format\\n' \"$sh\"\n315\t    fi\n316\t  done\n317\t  # === pattern B: CLAUDE_SESSION_ID marker (L-S48m-1) ===\n318\t  for sh in scripts/hooks/*.sh; do\n319\t    if grep -nE '\\.\\w+-fired-\\$\\{?CLAUDE_SESSION_ID' \"$sh\" >/dev/null; then\n320\t      printf '[B] %s: marker uses $CLAUDE_SESSION_ID (empty on Windows; L-S48m-1)\\n' \"$sh\"\n321\t    fi\n322\t  done\n323\t  # === pattern C: pipefail + ERR trap + bare grep (L-S48d-1) ===\n324\t  for sh in scripts/hooks/*.sh; do\n325\t    if grep -lE 'set [^#]*pipefail' \"$sh\" >/dev/null && \\\n326\t       grep -lE \"trap '[^']*' ERR\" \"$sh\" >/dev/null; then\n327\t      # check for bare `grep` not followed by `|| true` or wrapped in `{ ... || true; }`\n328\t      if grep -nE '^\\s+grep [^|]*$' \"$sh\" >/dev/null; then\n329\t        printf '[C] %s: pipefail + ERR trap + bare grep — wrap with || true (L-S48d-1)\\n' \"$sh\"\n330\t      fi\n331\t    fi\n332\t  done\n333\t  ```\n334\t- **Companion firing-test strategy**: stage 3 synthetic hook scripts in temp dir — one with pattern A, one with pattern B, one with pattern C; assert lint emits 3 distinct flags. Negative case: 1 clean script → assert 0 flags.\n335\t- **Severity emitted**: medium (warn — author-time discipline, not runtime block)\n336\t\n337\t**Cheapest-first justification**: HOOK extension is +30 LOC vs new hook +60 LOC. {"parentUuid":"1caeffac-a47b-44ea-abab-d7b39be4667e","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"297e2cd3-1e2c-42b7-b0c0-fdd8a4b89bd1","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_0169e4hD1CsbX2HWBUDLyh2t","type":"tool_result","content":"1\t#!/usr/bin/env bash\n2\t# autonomous-stop-watchdog.sh — Stop hook detector for Mode A/B/C/D loop-break patterns.\n3\t# Logs suspected loop-break to .autonomous-stop-watchdog.log; auto-recovers via\n4\t# continue-injector.ps1 (Mode-B under wind-down, Mode-C, Mode-D under cliff)\n5\t# or session-self-reboot (Mode-B over wind-down, Mode-D over cliff).\n6\t# Ported from orch v2.2.0 (verbatim with STOCKFORGE_* env rename + ORCH_* fallback).\n7\t# Mode-D = clean-handoff (S14 mid-session add per user \"why not autonomous continue?\").\n8\t# Detects: no A/B/C suspected + checkpoints/latest.md mtime within last 60s + autonomous_mode=true.\n9\t# Pairs the existing failure-mode recovery with end-of-session continuation (clean session boundary).\n10\t\n11\tset -uo pipefail\n12\t\n13\tPROJECT_DIR=\"${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}\"\n14\tLOG_DIR=\"$PROJECT_DIR/agent-workspace/memory\"\n15\tmkdir -p \"$LOG_DIR\"\n16\tWATCHDOG_LOG=\"$LOG_DIR/.autonomous-stop-watchdog.log\"\n17\tTS=\"$(date -Iseconds 2>/dev/null || date)\"\n18\t\n19\t# 1. Are we in autonomous mode?\n20\tEXEC_FILE=\"$PROJECT_DIR/agent-workspace/memory/current-execution.md\"\n21\tif [[ ! -f \"$EXEC_FILE\" ]]; then exit 0; fi\n22\tif ! grep -qE '^\\*\\*autonomous_mode\\*\\*:\\s*true' \"$EXEC_FILE\" 2>/dev/null; then exit 0; fi\n23\t\n24\t# 2. Read Stop hook stdin (jq preferred; bash regex fallback for Windows-without-jq).\n25\tSTDIN_JSON=\"$(cat 2>/dev/null || true)\"\n26\tTRANSCRIPT_PATH=\"\"\n27\tSESSION_ID=\"\"\n28\tif [[ -n \"$STDIN_JSON\" ]]; then\n29\t  if command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1; then\n30\t    TRANSCRIPT_PATH=\"$(printf '%s' \"$STDIN_JSON\" | jq -r '.transcript_path // empty' 2>/dev/null || true)\"\n31\t    SESSION_ID=\"$(printf '%s' \"$STDIN_JSON\" | jq -r '.session_id // empty' 2>/dev/null || true)\"\n32\t  else\n33\t    if [[ \"$STDIN_JSON\" =~ \\\"transcript_path\\\"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*\\\"([^\\\"]+)\\\" ]]; then\n34\t      TRANSCRIPT_PATH=\"${BASH_REMATCH[1]}\"\n35\t    fi\n36\t    if [[ \"$STDIN_JSON\" =~ \\\"session_id\\\"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*\\\"([^\\\"]+)\\\" ]]; then\n37\t      SESSION_ID=\"${BASH_REMATCH[1]}\"\n38\t    fi\n39\t  fi\n40\tfi\n41\t\n42\t# 3. Inspect last assistant text for narration-as-action / API error / premature-windown / self-pause.\n43\tNARRATION_HIT=\"\"\n44\tSELF_PAUSE_HIT=\"\"\n45\tAPI_ERROR_HIT=\"\"\n46\tAPI_REQUEST_ID=\"\"\n47\tPREMATURE_WINDOWN_HIT=\"\"\n48\tREAL_TRANSCRIPT_TOKENS=\"\"\n49\tWIND_DOWN_MARKER=\"\"\n50\tif [[ -n \"$TRANSCRIPT_PATH\" && -f \"$TRANSCRIPT_PATH\" ]]; then\n51\t  LAST_TAIL=\"$(tail -c 8192 \"$TRANSCRIPT_PATH\" 2>/dev/null || true)\"\n52\t  # Failure mode A: narration verbs WITHOUT tool_use block in same tail.\n53\t  if printf '%s' \"$LAST_TAIL\" | grep -qiE '(Dispatching|Now running|Now dispatching|Will dispatch|Will run|Awaiting (sandwich|task|spec|code|systematic|verifier|reviewer|implementer))' ; then\n54\t    if ! printf '%s' \"$LAST_TAIL\" | grep -qE '\"type\":\"tool_use\"' ; then\n55\t      NARRATION_HIT=\"suspected\"\n56\t    fi\n57\t  fi\n58\t  # Failure mode E (S44 user-observed): self-pause pattern — LLM explicitly abdicates\n59\t  # in autonomous-full mode by saying \"wait for fresh session\" / \"session boundary\" /\n60\t  # \"Stop hook handles\" instead of executing next-action. Distinct from narration_hit\n61\t  # (which is \"I will do X\" without doing X); self-pause is \"I'll stop here, fresh\n62\t  # context picks up next session\" without dispatching anything. {"parentUuid":"1580e534-d041-42b5-a24f-3745c344a271","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-opus-4-7","id":"msg_01T533qE1Qocd3G1jPmCPBDW","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01CPXmgWJH12kqQJnuBHWv5C","name":"Edit","input":{"replace_all":false,"file_path":"C:\\htdocs\\stockforge\\scripts\\hooks\\bash-hook-lint.sh","old_string":"    HITS=\"$(grep -nE \"$REGRESSION_PATTERN\" \"$t\" 2>/dev/null || true)\"\n    while IFS= read -r line; do\n      [ -z \"$line\" ] && continue\n      if printf '%s' \"$line\" | grep -qiE 'fabricated|deprecated|anti-pattern|never user-authorized|do NOT|MUST NOT|forbidden|not user-authorized'; then\n        continue\n      fi\n      emit \"D-IDENTITY-AUTONOMOUS-REGRESSION\" \"$rel\" \"live-config line matches forbidden pattern: $(printf '%s' \"$line\" | cut -c1-100)\"\n      break\n    done <<< \"$HITS\"\n  fi\ndone\n\n# === Emit results ===","new_string":"    HITS=\"$(grep -nE \"$REGRESSION_PATTERN\" \"$t\" 2>/dev/null || true)\"\n    while IFS= read -r line; do\n      [ -z \"$line\" ] && continue\n      if printf '%s' \"$line\" | grep -qiE 'fabricated|deprecated|anti-pattern|never user-authorized|do NOT|MUST NOT|forbidden|not user-authorized'; then\n        continue\n      fi\n      emit \"D-IDENTITY-AUTONOMOUS-REGRESSION\" \"$rel\" \"live-config line matches forbidden pattern: $(printf '%s' \"$line\" | cut -c1-100)\"\n      break\n    done <<< \"$HITS\"\n  fi\ndone\n\n# === Check 5: M-S51-1 grep-on-imagined-format anti-pattern (Pattern A) ===\n# Origin: S51 T3.1 — promotion-cycle-trigger.sh greped literal `^**Session N**:` against\n# real `## SXX —` header format → 0 matches → silent broken hook for ~12hr.\n# Generalize: detect literal `**Session N**` (with capital N as placeholder, never real text)\n# in grep/sed/awk patterns within hook scripts.\nif [ -d \"$HOOKS_DIR\" ]; then\n  for f in \"$HOOKS_DIR\"/*.sh; do\n    [ ! -f \"$f\" ] && continue\n    bn=\"$(basename \"$f\")\"\n    [ \"$bn\" = \"bash-hook-lint.sh\" ] && continue\n    BAD_A=\"$(grep -nE \"(grep|sed|awk).*[\\\\^]?[*][*]Session N[*][*]\" \"$f\" 2>/dev/null | grep -vE \"^[[:space:]]*[0-9]+:[[:space:]]*#\" || true)\"\n    if [ -n \"$BAD_A\" ]; then\n      emit \"M-S51-1-IMAGINED-FORMAT\" \"$bn\" \"literal '**Session N**' grep — verify against real current-execution.md format (L-S51-1)\"\n    fi\n  done\nfi\n\n# === Check 6: L-S48m-1 CLAUDE_SESSION_ID empty-on-Windows anti-pattern (Pattern B) ===\n# Origin: S48m profile-template-auto-populate.sh — marker filename used $CLAUDE_SESSION_ID\n# without :- fallback; on Windows the env var is empty → marker collides on every fire →\n# silent skip after first fire. exit 1; }\n\nTEMPDIR=$(mktemp -d)\ntrap 'rm -rf \"$TEMPDIR\"' EXIT\n\nmkdir -p \"$TEMPDIR/agent-workspace/memory/observations\"\nPENDING_DIR=\"$TEMPDIR/agent-workspace/memory\"\n\nNOW_S=$(date +%s)\nNOW_MS=$(( NOW_S * 1000 ))\nFRESH_MS=$(( NOW_MS - 600000 ))   # 10 min ago\nSTALE_MS=$(( NOW_MS - 8000000 ))  # ~2.2 hr ago\n\nclean_logs() {\n  rm -f \"$PENDING_DIR\"/.dispatch-pending-*.jsonl\n  rm -f \"$TEMPDIR/agent-workspace/memory/.in-flight-subagent-watcher.log\"\n}\n\nPASS=0; FAIL=0\n\n# === TC1: fresh pending → NO alert ===\nclean_logs\ncat > \"$PENDING_DIR/.dispatch-pending-test1.jsonl\" <<EOF\n{\"dispatch_id\":\"fresh-1\",\"state\":\"pending\",\"ts_ms\":$FRESH_MS,\"expected_observation_path\":\"agent-workspace/memory/observations/fresh-obs.md\"}\nEOF\nSTDERR_TC1=$(CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR=\"$TEMPDIR\" bash \"$HOOK\" 2>&1 >/dev/null || true)\nif printf '%s' \"$STDERR_TC1\" | grep -q \"stale pending dispatch\"; then\n  printf 'FAIL [TC1] fresh dispatch alerted: %s\\n' \"$STDERR_TC1\"\n  FAIL=$((FAIL+1))\nelse\n  echo \"PASS [TC1] fresh dispatch (10min) → no alert\"\n  PASS=$((PASS+1))\nfi\n\n# === TC2: stale pending without observation → ALERT ===\nclean_logs\ncat > \"$PENDING_DIR/.dispatch-pending-test2.jsonl\" <<EOF\n{\"dispatch_id\":\"stale-noobs\",\"state\":\"pending\",\"ts_ms\":$STALE_MS,\"expected_observation_path\":\"agent-workspace/memory/observations/missing-obs.md\"}\nEOF\nSTDERR_TC2=$(CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR=\"$TEMPDIR\" bash \"$HOOK\" 2>&1 >/dev/null || true)\nif printf '%s' \"$STDERR_TC2\" | grep -q \"stale pending dispatch\"; then\n  echo \"PASS [TC2] stale pending without observation → alert\"\n  PASS=$((PASS+1))\nelse\n  printf 'FAIL [TC2] stale-no-obs did NOT alert: %s\\n' \"$STDERR_TC2\"\n  cat \"$TEMPDIR/agent-workspace/memory/.in-flight-subagent-watcher.log\" 2>/dev/null || true\n  FAIL=$((FAIL+1))\nfi\n\n# === TC3: stale pending WITH observation file → NO alert (subagent completed) ===\nclean_logs\nprintf 'observation arrived\\n' > \"$TEMPDIR/agent-workspace/memory/observations/arrived-obs.md\"\ncat > \"$PENDING_DIR/.dispatch-pending-test3.jsonl\" <<EOF\n{\"dispatch_id\":\"stale-withobs\",\"state\":\"pending\",\"ts_ms\":$STALE_MS,\"expected_observation_path\":\"agent-workspace/memory/observations/arrived-obs.md\"}\nEOF\nSTDERR_TC3=$(CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR=\"$TEMPDIR\" bash \"$HOOK\" 2>&1 >/dev/null || true)\nif printf '%s' \"$STDERR_TC3\" | grep -q \"stale pending dispatch\";
